text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On our way back from an outing, Gran Alegria and I spotted Curren Bouquetd'or standing in front of a flower shop.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, both of you.
What a coincidence."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Were you looking at the flowers, Bouquet-san?
Whoa~! There are so many kinds.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if there's a flower named "Mile"!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu. It might just exist. It simply hasn't been found yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is my intention.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been thinking about what flowers to put in my room.
...Flowers that make you feel the "wind."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The wind? Why??

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...A dust wind, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"A dust storm... Ah, indeed.
There was construction near the dorms,
so the wind must have carried it over here..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We won't be able to open the windows for a while.
Let's look forward to the time
when we can feel the breeze again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"A dust storm... At first I thought
it was your usual metaphor,
but there's quite a lot of dust on the windows."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It'll still be a few days before we can open the windows... so I thought it'd be nice to place something here to bring some comfort.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all.
I am simply doing
what I wish to do."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, what does a breeze of flowers mean?
Like... the language of flowers?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely as well, but...
For instance, baby's breath.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
They are such tiny flowers,
even just walking past makes them sway.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Swaying gently.
Just like catching a soft breeze
in the middle of an open meadow—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So I was thinking... maybe I could
prepare a bouquet like that..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, how nice.
It's so soothing, it'll warm my heart right up.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it looks so fun!
Maybe I should decorate my room too!
With something that screams "Mile"!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let's pick them out together, one by one!
The theme is the Mile, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Gran Alegria, I look over the flowers lined up.
If I were to decide purely on intuition—
choice_data_list: Let's go with that flower standing straight up over there.
Maybe one with lots of flowers would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a big flower!
Standing straight up...
Even just a single bloom really stands out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Is this... your vision of the Mile, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What came to mind was Gran Alegria's image.
An unwavering, strong, and upright figure standing tall—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. So Trainer thought of me
when it came to the Mile~

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Then maybe I'll try
imagining 'Miles and Trainer' too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it looks like we can make a wonderful bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, looks great!
Putting flowers in a room
really does change the atmosphere~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
There are so many on a single branch~!
Is this Trainer's image of the mile?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle rustling sound echoes.
It is far too quiet to be called applause,
yet that is the exact image that came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...It is an ovation of flowers, isn't it?
It seems to gently resonate deep within my heart."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! That's so great!!
The mile... no, you're picturing when I
become the Mile Queen, right?
choice_data_list: It's not exactly a thunderous applause with such a quiet sound, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Applause comes from feelings! No matter how loud it echoes, without feelings behind it, it means nothing.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll go with the same flowers.
If I buy a bunch and bouquet them together,
maybe it'll brighten up my room?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, looks great!
Putting flowers in a room
really does change the atmosphere~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That vision you had, Trainer,
it was all thought up with me in mind, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The theme was the mile, and since I'm going to be the Mile Queen, maybe it's only natural, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder why.
Just looking at it makes power well up inside me.
My legs are itching to run, too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gran Alegria poked at the flowers with her fingertip, her face breaking into a bright smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I took out my smartphone
and snapped a photo—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I'll make this my good luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She held it closely against her chest.
